title: dislodge — significance

sentences.sentence: Ian dislodged a few stones as he climbed up the rock.
sentences.translation: 伊恩攀岩的时候敲掉了几块石头。

sentences.sentence: The earthquake wreaked havoc on the city.
sentences.translation: 地震对这座城市造成了大破坏。

sentences.sentence: Regrettably, it is also in these 100 years that humanity has experienced unprecedented hardships, particularly the havoc of the two world wars.
sentences.translation: 令人遗憾的是，人类在这100年中也经历了前所未有的苦难，特别是遭受了两次世界大战的浩劫。

translations.translation: 承担责任的； 作为原因的

sentences.sentence: We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.
sentences.translation: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

sentences.sentence: I have a passion for archaeology .
sentences.translation: 我对考古学有热情。

sentences.sentence: He displayed interest in archaeology.
sentences.translation: 他对考古学有兴趣。

sentences.sentence: His special interest was archaeology and art history.
sentences.translation: 他对考古学和艺术史有特殊的兴趣。

sentences.sentence: I enumerate the work that will have to be done.
sentences.translation: 我将必须要做的工作一一列举出来。

sentences.sentence: A win is always good for morale.
sentences.translation: 胜利总是可以鼓舞士气。

sentences.sentence: The failed coup caused a loss of morale within the army.
sentences.translation: 政变未遂挫伤了军队的士气。

sentences.sentence: the Prince’s morale-boosting (= intended to raise morale ) mission to the war﹣torn country
sentences.translation: 王子去这个饱受战争磨难的国家鼓舞士气的使命

sentences.sentence: British expatriates living in Spain
sentences.translation: 生活在西班牙的英国侨民

sentences.sentence: A single candle illuminated his face.
sentences.translation: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

sentences.sentence: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
sentences.translation: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

sentences.sentence: Neither the lizard nor the glass has any secrets.
sentences.translation: 无论是蜥蜴还是玻璃，都没有任何秘密。

sentences.sentence: Meetings are just one symptom of an organization run by the lizard brain.
sentences.translation: 会海只是这类靠蜥蜴脑运作的组织的一个症状。

sentences.sentence: When air cools at night, dew collects on the lizard's skin and is pulled to its mouth by capillary action.
sentences.translation: 待晚间空气温度下降，凝结在蜥蜴皮肤上的露珠就可以通过毛细管作用输送到它的口中。

sentences.sentence: extremists on the periphery of the animal rights movement
sentences.translation: 处于动物权利运动边缘的极端分子

sentences.sentence: He spoke, unequivocally, of the United States' "unbreakable" commitment to Israel and of why Iran must not have a nuclear weapon.
sentences.translation: 他明确地说到，美国对以色列的承诺“牢不可破”，以及为什么伊朗绝不能拥有核武器。

sentences.sentence: Dear Humans, in closing, let me express unequivocally that I and the Angelic Realm are in a special role of supporting you far more than you may realize.
sentences.translation: 亲爱的人们，结束之前，请允许我一点也不含糊地说明，我以及天使界扮演着支持你们的特殊角色，我们的支持远比你们想象的多。

translations.translation: 拥抱； 信奉； 接受

sentences.sentence: Jack warmly embraced his son.
sentences.translation: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

sentences.sentence: Maggie and Laura embraced.
sentences.translation: 玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

sentences.sentence: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
sentences.translation: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

sentences.sentence: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
sentences.translation: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

sentences.sentence: So tell me about. You have done music, where do these things intersect for you?
sentences.translation: 那么，你已经做过音乐和，艺术，这些事情的交叉点在哪里呢？

sentences.sentence: How many times do the road and railway intersect (with one another) on this map?
sentences.translation: 在这张地图上公路与铁路（彼此）相交共有多少次?。

sentences.sentence: Do you see any grey dots where the black lines intersect? In fact, there is nothing.
sentences.translation: 在黑色线条的交叉处，你能看到灰色的点儿吗？实际上，什么都没有。

phrases.translation: 生物固氮；生物固氮酌；生物固氮作用

sentences.sentence: All of these from the group one and two through the group five and six elements, but what about elements, what about molecules like hydrogen, or nitrogen, or maybe oxygen?
sentences.translation: 所有的这些都是来自于第一主族和第二组主族，到第五主族和第六组主族的悬殊，那么元素呢，比如氢气，氮气或氧气那样的分子呢？

sentences.sentence: Here is our accumulator which has that nitrogen overpressure which upon loss of pressure in the core would automatically insert coolant into the core should there be a break.
sentences.translation: 这是我们的蓄电池，那已经氮过度增压，面临着在核心里压力的损失，那会自动的加入冷却剂到，核心去，然后就会产生一个破裂。

translations.translation: 木器； 木工手艺； [木]木工业

sentences.sentence: The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
sentences.translation: 苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。

sentences.sentence: Rinse off any soap residue.
sentences.translation: 冲净残留的肥皂。

phrases.translation: 温哥华水族馆（北美洲三大水族馆之一）

sentences.sentence: We saw a ray at the aquarium.
sentences.translation: 我们在水族馆看见了一只鳐。

sentences.sentence: In Amsterdam the girls all stand in the windows shimmering as tantalising as tropical fish beyond the gleam of aquarium glass.
sentences.translation: 在阿姆斯特丹，姑娘们都站在窗后，光芒四射柔情撩人宛如水族馆玻璃背后脉脉含情的热带鱼。

sentences.sentence: Recently the bakers created an octopus complete with tentacles and suckers for a charity event held for a local aquarium.
sentences.translation: 最近，面包师为当地水族馆举行的慈善活动制作了这只章鱼，它拥有完整的触手和吸盘。

phrases.translation: 显著性检验；显著性测定

sentences.sentence: Ideas about the social significance of religion have changed over time.
sentences.translation: 有关宗教的社会意义的观念已随时间的流逝发生了改变。

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 249 单元

dislodge
音标：英 /dɪs'lɑːdʒ/  美 /dɪs'lɑdʒ/
v.  逐出； 去除
例句：Ian dislodged a few stones as he climbed up the rock.
伊恩攀岩的时候敲掉了几块石头。

havoc
音标：英 /'hævək/  美 /'hævək/
n.  大破坏， 浩劫
短语：wreak havoc — 肆虐；造成严重破坏
短语：play havoc with — 毁坏；使陷入大混乱
例句：The earthquake wreaked havoc on the city.
地震对这座城市造成了大破坏。
例句：Regrettably, it is also in these 100 years that humanity has experienced unprecedented hardships, particularly the havoc of the two world wars.
令人遗憾的是，人类在这100年中也经历了前所未有的苦难，特别是遭受了两次世界大战的浩劫。

responsible
音标：英 /rɪ'spɑːnsəbl/  美 /rɪ'spɑnsəbl/
adj.  承担责任的； 作为原因的
短语：responsible for — 是…的原由；为…负责
短语：responsible person — 负责人
短语：be responsible to sb — 对某人负责
短语：responsible department — 负责单位
短语：responsible official — n. 负责人
短语：responsible stakeholder — 有责任的利益相关者
短语：responsible officer — 负责人员
短语：responsible care — 责任关怀
例句：We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.
我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

archaeology
音标：英 /ˌɑːrki'ɑːlədʒi/  美 /,ɑrkɪ'ɑlədʒi/
n.  考古学
例句：I have a passion for archaeology .
我对考古学有热情。
例句：He displayed interest in archaeology.
他对考古学有兴趣。
例句：His special interest was archaeology and art history.
他对考古学和艺术史有特殊的兴趣。

enumerate
音标：英 /ɪ'nuːməreɪt/  美 /ɪ'numəret/
v.  列举， 枚举
例句：I enumerate the work that will have to be done.
我将必须要做的工作一一列举出来。

morale
音标：英 /mə'ræl/  美 /mə'ræl/
n.  士气
短语：good morale — 高昂士气；昂扬士气
例句：A win is always good for morale.
胜利总是可以鼓舞士气。
例句：The failed coup caused a loss of morale within the army.
政变未遂挫伤了军队的士气。
例句：the Prince’s morale-boosting (= intended to raise morale ) mission to the war﹣torn country
王子去这个饱受战争磨难的国家鼓舞士气的使命

expatriate
音标：英 /ˌeks'peɪtriət/  美 /,ɛks'petrɪət/
v. 移居国外；
n.  移居国外的人
例句：British expatriates living in Spain
生活在西班牙的英国侨民

illuminate
音标：英 /ɪ'luːmɪneɪt/  美 /ɪ'lumɪnet/
v.  照明； 说明
例句：A single candle illuminated his face.
一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。
例句：At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

lizard
音标：英 /'lɪzərd/  美 /'lɪzɚd/
n.  蜥蜴
例句：Neither the lizard nor the glass has any secrets.
无论是蜥蜴还是玻璃，都没有任何秘密。
例句：Meetings are just one symptom of an organization run by the lizard brain.
会海只是这类靠蜥蜴脑运作的组织的一个症状。
例句：When air cools at night, dew collects on the lizard's skin and is pulled to its mouth by capillary action.
待晚间空气温度下降，凝结在蜥蜴皮肤上的露珠就可以通过毛细管作用输送到它的口中。

periphery
音标：英 /pə'rɪfəri/  美 /pə'rɪfəri/
n.  外围
例句：extremists on the periphery of the animal rights movement
处于动物权利运动边缘的极端分子

preoccupation
音标：英 /priˌɑːkju'peɪʃn/  美 /prɪ,ɑkju'peʃən/
n. 先入之见；； 入神

unequivocally
音标：英 /ˌʌnɪ'kwɪvəkəli/
adv.  不含糊地； 明确地
例句：He spoke, unequivocally, of the United States' "unbreakable" commitment to Israel and of why Iran must not have a nuclear weapon.
他明确地说到，美国对以色列的承诺“牢不可破”，以及为什么伊朗绝不能拥有核武器。
例句：Dear Humans, in closing, let me express unequivocally that I and the Angelic Realm are in a special role of supporting you far more than you may realize.
亲爱的人们，结束之前，请允许我一点也不含糊地说明，我以及天使界扮演着支持你们的特殊角色，我们的支持远比你们想象的多。

embrace
音标：英 /ɪm'breɪs/  美 /ɪm'bres/
v.  拥抱； 信奉； 接受
短语：warm embrace — 温暖的拥抱
例句：Jack warmly embraced his son.
杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。
例句：Maggie and Laura embraced.
玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

identify
音标：英 /aɪ'dentɪfaɪ/  美 /aɪ'dɛntɪfaɪ/
v.  识别， 鉴别
短语：identify oneself — 证明自己(的身份)
短语：identify with — 认为…等同于，与一致
例句：He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。
例句：The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

intersect
音标：英 /ˌɪntər'sekt/  美 /'ɪntɚ'sɛkt/
v.  相交
例句：So tell me about. You have done music, where do these things intersect for you?
那么，你已经做过音乐和，艺术，这些事情的交叉点在哪里呢？
例句：How many times do the road and railway intersect (with one another) on this map?
在这张地图上公路与铁路（彼此）相交共有多少次?。
例句：Do you see any grey dots where the black lines intersect? In fact, there is nothing.
在黑色线条的交叉处，你能看到灰色的点儿吗？实际上，什么都没有。

nitrogen
音标：英 /'naɪtrədʒən/  美 /'naɪtrədʒən/
n.  氮
短语：ammonia nitrogen — 氨氮；氨型氮，氨基氮
短语：nitrogen content — 含氮量；总氮量
短语：total nitrogen — 总氮，总氮量
短语：nitrogen fertilizer — 氮肥；氮肥肥料
短语：liquid nitrogen — 液氮
短语：nitrogen oxide — 氧化氮；氮的氧化物
短语：nitrogen source — 氮源；氮源物质
短语：nitrogen fixation — [化]固氮作用
短语：nitrate nitrogen — 硝态氮；硝酸盐氮
短语：urea nitrogen — 尿素氮；脲氮
短语：nitrogen metabolism — 氮代谢
短语：nitrogen concentration — 氮浓度
短语：amino nitrogen — [化]氨基氮
短语：nitrogen dioxide — [化]二氧化氮
短语：nitrogen supply — 氮供应
短语：nitrogen balance — [生化]氮平衡
短语：biological nitrogen fixation — 生物固氮；生物固氮酌；生物固氮作用
短语：nitrogen cycle — 氮循环
短语：nitrogen flow — 氮化怜
短语：nitrogen treatment — 氮化处理
例句：All of these from the group one and two through the group five and six elements, but what about elements, what about molecules like hydrogen, or nitrogen, or maybe oxygen?
所有的这些都是来自于第一主族和第二组主族，到第五主族和第六组主族的悬殊，那么元素呢，比如氢气，氮气或氧气那样的分子呢？
例句：Here is our accumulator which has that nitrogen overpressure which upon loss of pressure in the core would automatically insert coolant into the core should there be a break.
这是我们的蓄电池，那已经氮过度增压，面临着在核心里压力的损失，那会自动的加入冷却剂到，核心去，然后就会产生一个破裂。

carpentry
音标：英 /'kɑːrpəntri/  美 /'kɑrpəntri/
n.  木器； 木工手艺； [木]木工业

residue
音标：英 /'rezɪduː/  美 /'rɛzɪdu/
n.  剩余物； 残余
短语：pesticide residue — [药]农药残留（量）
短语：oil residue — 油渣，油残留物；残油
短语：carbon residue — 焦炭残渣；炭渣
短语：filter residue — [化]滤渣
短语：amount of residue — 残留量
短语：amino acid residue — 氨基酸残基
短语：quadratic residue — 二次剩余
短语：solid residue — 固体残渣
例句：The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。
例句：Rinse off any soap residue.
冲净残留的肥皂。

aquarium
音标：英 /ə'kweriəm/  美 /ə'kwɛrɪəm/
n.  水族馆； 养鱼池
短语：vancouver aquarium — 温哥华水族馆（北美洲三大水族馆之一）
例句：We saw a ray at the aquarium.
我们在水族馆看见了一只鳐。
例句：In Amsterdam the girls all stand in the windows shimmering as tantalising as tropical fish beyond the gleam of aquarium glass.
在阿姆斯特丹，姑娘们都站在窗后，光芒四射柔情撩人宛如水族馆玻璃背后脉脉含情的热带鱼。
例句：Recently the bakers created an octopus complete with tentacles and suckers for a charity event held for a local aquarium.
最近，面包师为当地水族馆举行的慈善活动制作了这只章鱼，它拥有完整的触手和吸盘。

significance
音标：英 /sɪg'nɪfɪkəns/  美 /sɪɡ'nɪfɪkəns/
n.  意义； 重要性
短语：economic significance — 经济重要性
短语：statistical significance — 统计显著性；统计数据
短语：significance test — 显著性检验；显著性测定
短语：significance level — [化]显著水平，显著性水平
短语：political significance — 政治意义
短语：level of significance — 显著性水准
短语：psychological significance — 心理学意义
短语：significance of difference — 差异显著性
例句：Ideas about the social significance of religion have changed over time.
有关宗教的社会意义的观念已随时间的流逝发生了改变。
